observations.text: SP, due to a non-standardized review of the Training Exercise before the sortie, did not identify the special requirements specified for this training unit and did not sequence them into the mission profile. Two of the required items were not initiated at the planned points and remained outstanding at the start of the recovery. SP did not complete the special requirements without assistance, with the result that the IP directed the sequence and executed part of the setup for the remaining item.

SP, due to lack of knowledge of the published procedure for the condition encountered, did not accomplish the special requirement directed by the Training Exercise analysis for this training unit. The required item was left incomplete and was not recognized as outstanding before the recovery was commenced. SP did not complete the requirement without assistance, with the result that the IP directed the actions and performed part of the procedure. Study of the applicable procedures and limits before the next Training Section is required.

SP accomplished the special requirements specified in the Training Exercise for this training unit within the desired standard for this Training Section, completing two of them only after the IP's verbal prompts. Recognition that a required item remained outstanding was delayed until the IP called for it, although no intervention on the controls was needed. Marginal performance for the Training Section; independent tracking of the special requirements against the Training Exercise and earlier self-identification of outstanding items are expected to improve.

SP planned and accomplished all special requirements directed by the Training Exercise analysis for this training unit without verbal prompts from the IP. Minor errors in the sequencing of two requirements were recognized and corrected in a timely manner without IP's intervention. Above end of block MIF achieved.

SP accomplished every special requirement specified in the Training Exercise for this training unit with accuracy and speed, at the planned points of the mission profile. Knowledge of the applicable procedures and limits was sufficient throughout, and neither verbal prompts nor intervention from the IP were required. Above end of block MIF achieved.

SP accomplished all special requirements directed by the Training Exercise analysis with exceptional accuracy, integrating them into the mission profile without degrading the instrument cross-check or the planned timing. Deviations in sequencing and execution were negligible, and SP briefed the applicable procedures and limits for each requirement before its execution. Performance exceeded the levels desired for this Training Section, with no IP prompting at any point of the sortie. Above end of block MIF achieved.
